listing.name: Fist of the North Star: Lost Paradise — port-ga-gotoku (ItalianKuze)
listing.original_game_title: Fist of the North Star: Lost Paradise
listing.summary: Experimental project. Upstream early alpha playable exploration/combat/save/load around 60 FPS on one Windows 11/RTX5070 machine; drops/issues remain. No full campaign or alternate-source qualification. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Fist of the North Star: Lost Paradise PS4 CUSA12781 v01.00 dump with eboot.bin/sce_sys. CUSA10053 Asian edition is only an experimental prologue→first save report, not equivalent source qualification.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Manual release ZIP writable folder or MSYS2UCRT64 build-win.sh; launcher selects owned CUSA12781 folder and prepares boot image read-only. Alternate Asian edition requires confirmation. No archive inspected.

warnings: Upstream early alpha playable exploration/combat/save/load around 60 FPS on one Windows 11/RTX5070 machine; drops/issues remain. No full campaign or alternate-source qualification.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
